instructions: Choose the ordinary keyboard and mouse inputs for the next two seconds. Use the latest screenshot and the actual input history. Waiting is appropriate only for visible loading, transitions or cutscenes.

move.instructions: This group holds one direction with the W, A, S and D movement keys every step.

up_left.description: Hold the W and A keys.

up_right.description: Hold the W and D keys.

down_left.description: Hold the S and A keys.

down_right.description: Hold the S and D keys.

hand.instructions: This group holds the tool and interaction keys.

none.description: Do not hold C or X.

use.description: Hold the C key, which uses the selected tool or item.

check.description: Hold the X key, which checks, talks to or interacts with what the farmer faces.

keys.instructions: This group presses one number key that selects a toolbar slot or one menu key.

none.description: Press no toolbar or menu key.

slot_1.description: Press the 1 key, which selects toolbar slot 1.

slot_2.description: Press the 2 key, which selects toolbar slot 2.

slot_3.description: Press the 3 key, which selects toolbar slot 3.

slot_4.description: Press the 4 key, which selects toolbar slot 4.

slot_5.description: Press the 5 key, which selects toolbar slot 5.

slot_6.description: Press the 6 key, which selects toolbar slot 6.

slot_7.description: Press the 7 key, which selects toolbar slot 7.

slot_8.description: Press the 8 key, which selects toolbar slot 8.

slot_9.description: Press the 9 key, which selects toolbar slot 9.

slot_10.description: Press the 0 key, which selects toolbar slot 10.

menu.description: Press the E key, which opens or closes the inventory and game menu.

escape.description: Press the Escape key, which opens the game menu or closes the open menu.

journal.description: Press the F key, which opens or closes the quest journal.

map.description: Press the M key, which opens or closes the map.

point.instructions: Choose no mouse input or a left or right click at a target you locate in the current screenshot. A mouse click replaces the keyboard inputs for this step.

none.description: Do not click; execute the selected keyboard inputs.

left_click.description: Left-click a visible target, such as a menu button, toolbar slot, inventory item or world tile.

right_click.description: Right-click a visible target to interact with it or use the selected item.
